manifest.author: Jagmeet Chabra
manifest.description: Configure once, then on a schedule sweeps a locked list of authoritative sources (auto-discovered at setup, confirmed by the user) plus any user-supplied seeds. Classifies each item, flags items relevant to the user's team using a light WorkIQ-derived profile, and renders a self-contained HTML dashboard. A tightly-bounded fallback web search is used only when a locked source is silent in the wind…
